description: Draft a structured 1:1 agenda (Markdown) for a manager and a direct report, time-boxed to the meeting length. Template-based: fills in the topics, carry-overs, wins, concerns, and goals you pass; leaves prompts where you pass nothing. Puts the report's topics first.
